Title: Digital Transformation of Land Records: Lessons from State Rollouts
Summary: Reviews how digitization of land records under national modernization programmes has affected record accuracy, title clarity, and citizen access to land information, and identifies common implementation bottlenecks across states.

Title: Climate-Resilient Land Use Planning in Coastal Odisha
Summary: Examines how cyclone and flood exposure has shaped land-use zoning decisions in coastal districts, and evaluates the effectiveness of setback rules and wetland buffers in reducing vulnerability.

Title: Urban Sprawl and Agricultural Land Conversion in the Delhi-NCR Region
Summary: Analyzes the pace of peri-urban agricultural land conversion around Delhi-NCR over two decades and its implications for food-producing land, using satellite-derived land-cover change data.

Title: Tenure Security and Land Dispute Resolution Mechanisms in Bihar
Summary: Assesses the effectiveness of revenue courts and alternative dispute resolution forums in reducing pending land dispute caseloads, and proposes a fast-track mediation model.

Title: Remote Sensing for Monitoring Encroachment on Forest and Common Land
Summary: Presents a methodology using multi-temporal satellite imagery to detect encroachment on forest and community land, supporting enforcement and restoration planning.

Title: Land Acquisition for Infrastructure Corridors: Compensation and Resettlement Outcomes
Summary: Studies compensation adequacy and resettlement outcomes for households displaced by highway and rail corridor projects, highlighting gaps between policy entitlements and delivery.

Title: Gender Gaps in Land Ownership and Inheritance Practices
Summary: Documents persistent gaps in women's recorded land ownership despite legal inheritance rights, and reviews state-level interventions such as joint titling incentives.

Title: Forest Rights Act Implementation and Tribal Land Titling in Central India
Summary: Evaluates the pace and quality of individual and community forest rights titling under the Forest Rights Act in tribal-dominated districts, and the barriers claimants face.

Title: Climate Vulnerability Mapping for Himalayan Land-Use Planning
Summary: Develops a composite climate vulnerability index combining slope instability, glacial lake outburst risk, and rainfall variability to guide land-use restrictions in hill towns.

Title: Digital Cadastral Surveys Using Drone-Based Mapping: A Pilot Assessment
Summary: Assesses accuracy, cost and time savings of drone-based cadastral resurvey pilots compared to traditional chain-and-tape survey methods.

Title: Urban-Rural Land Transition Governance in Peri-Urban Bengaluru
Summary: Explores how weak zoning enforcement in peri-urban Bengaluru has led to informal land conversion, and proposes a phased land-use transition framework.

Title: Land Dispute Density and Judicial Backlog: A Cross-State Comparison
Summary: Compares land-related litigation backlog across states relative to population and land parcel counts, identifying states where dispute density correlates with weaker record digitization.

Title: Satellite-Based Crop and Land-Cover Classification for Agricultural Land Monitoring
Summary: Applies multispectral satellite classification to track the extent of irrigated agricultural land and its year-on-year conversion to non-agricultural use.

Title: Infrastructure Corridors and Land Fragmentation in Rural Uttar Pradesh
Summary: Investigates how linear infrastructure projects have fragmented agricultural holdings and altered land access patterns for smallholder farmers.

Title: Institutional Capacity for Land Governance: A State Readiness Assessment
Summary: Proposes a readiness framework scoring states on digital record coverage, dispute resolution capacity, and staffing, to prioritize capacity-building support.

Title: Wetland and Water Body Encroachment in Rapidly Urbanizing Districts
Summary: Documents the loss of urban wetlands and water bodies to construction over a decade and links the loss to increased urban flooding incidents.

Title: Community Land Rights and Common Property Resource Governance
Summary: Reviews the legal status and on-ground management of common property resources such as village grazing land, and the effect of privatization pressure on rural livelihoods.

Title: Climate Migration and Land Pressure in the Sundarbans
Summary: Studies how repeated cyclone and salinity intrusion events are driving internal migration and reshaping land-use and tenure patterns in the Sundarbans delta.

Title: Blockchain-Based Land Record Integrity: A Feasibility Study
Summary: Evaluates the technical and institutional feasibility of blockchain-anchored land record systems for tamper-evidence, drawing on pilot implementations.

Title: Land Dispute Resolution Through Gram Nyayalayas: An Evaluation
Summary: Assesses whether village-level courts have reduced the time and cost of resolving minor land disputes compared to district revenue courts.

Title: Mapping Urban Heat and Land Governance Interlinkages in Metro Cities
Summary: Links urban land-use intensity and green-cover loss to rising urban heat island effects across major metropolitan areas.

Title: Infrastructure-Led Land Value Capture: Financing Urban Development
Summary: Reviews land value capture instruments used to finance metro rail and urban infrastructure, and their fiscal outcomes for state and municipal bodies.

Title: GIS-Based Decision Support for District-Level Land-Use Planning
Summary: Presents a GIS decision-support prototype that overlays land governance, climate, and infrastructure indicators to prioritize district-level planning interventions.

Title: Land Records Modernization and Agricultural Credit Access
Summary: Finds that clearer digitized land titles are associated with improved access to formal agricultural credit among smallholder farmers.

Title: Coastal Land Use Regulation and Fisher Community Land Access
Summary: Examines tension between coastal regulation zones intended for ecological protection and the customary land access needs of fishing communities.

Title: Urban Expansion Trends Along National Highway Corridors
Summary: Tracks ribbon development and land-use change along national highway corridors, finding accelerated non-agricultural conversion within five kilometres of new highways.

Title: Predictive Modelling of Land Dispute Hotspots Using Administrative Data
Summary: Builds a predictive model using historical case filings and land-record quality indicators to flag districts at elevated risk of rising land dispute volumes.

Title: Land Governance Reform and Ease of Doing Business Rankings
Summary: Analyzes the relationship between state-level land record digitization reforms and improvements in ease-of-doing-business indicators tied to property registration.

Title: Flood Risk Zoning and Compliance in Riverine Settlements
Summary: Studies compliance with floodplain zoning regulations in riverine settlements and the socio-economic factors driving continued construction in high-risk zones.

Title: Infrastructure Pressure and Groundwater-Linked Land Subsidence
Summary: Investigates land subsidence associated with groundwater extraction near dense infrastructure corridors and its long-term implications for structural safety.

Title: Land Titling Reform Pilots: A Comparative Review
Summary: Compares conclusive land titling pilot programmes across states, evaluating legal frameworks, survey accuracy requirements, and dispute-resolution safeguards.

Title: Hill-Slope Land Use and Landslide Risk in the North-East
Summary: Assesses how unregulated hill-slope construction and land clearing has contributed to increased landslide incidence in North-Eastern hill towns.

Title: Peri-Urban Land Markets and Informal Settlement Growth
Summary: Examines informal land transactions in peri-urban areas that precede formal urban expansion, and their implications for future regularization planning.

Title: Evidence-Based Prioritization of Land Governance Interventions
Summary: Proposes a composite risk-scoring approach to prioritize which districts should receive governance-strengthening investment first, based on multiple pressure indicators.

Title: Satellite Monitoring of Command Area Irrigation and Land Use Efficiency
Summary: Uses satellite time-series data to assess whether irrigation command areas are being used efficiently for intended agricultural purposes.

Title: Land Records Litigation Cost Burden on Smallholder Farmers
Summary: Quantifies the direct and indirect costs smallholder farmers bear while pursuing land dispute litigation, and their effect on farm investment decisions.
